name: paprika-observe
description: Discover and query Paprika observability providers, and create or update saved queries and dashboards with explicitly authorized Insights access.

interface.longDescription: Discover and query Paprika observability providers, and create or update saved queries and dashboards with explicitly authorized Insights access.
defaultPrompt: Discover the observability providers and the signals each supports.
Find metric names and labels before running a bounded metrics query.
Inspect recent logs and traces for one selected provider.
Create a saved query and dashboard from an authorized provider, then open it in Insights.
